structure.unit: State Agencies Related to the General Operation of Government

law.catch_line: Furnishing copies of documents at no cost to law-enforcement officials
law.text: All agencies and instrumentalities of the Commonwealth shall provide, at no cost, copies of documents requested by the Department of State Police or other law-enforcement officers as part of an active criminal investigation. "Law-enforcement officer" means the same as that term is defined in § 9.1-101.
